title: How Cardinals Get Their Rooms for a Papal Conclave
asof: Rules from Universi Dominici Gregis (1996) · May 2025 conclave · full video on the channel

shots.s: To choose a pope, cardinals move into a Vatican guesthouse.
It's called Casa Santa Marta, and it has a hundred and thirty-one rooms.
In 2025, Pope Francis's old rooms were sealed.
That left about a hundred and twenty-five rooms for a hundred and thirty-three cardinals.
They draw lots. Even when there's room for everyone.
A bed, a dresser, and a private bathroom with a shower.
The phones work, but nobody may call outside.
Internet and satellite TV are cut off.
Every room is swept for hidden bugs.
Could you live like that until a pope is chosen?
